王建新开着车往巴统方向走，还没进城就感觉不对劲了。

路上多了很多军警，检查站一个接一个。过往的车辆都会被拦下来排查，连行人也不放过，时不时被叫到路边盘问几句。街上的气氛很紧张，看来他们是想找到一些线索，可是他们做梦也想不到，居然还有带空间的人吧？

“看来巴统也戒严了。”王建新心里有数。他在苏联搞了这么多事情，莫斯科、巴统，仓库丢了那么多东西，银行金库被洗劫，军方不可能没反应。现在全苏联估计都在严查。

他赶忙把车找了个没人的地方收入空间，然后便躲在空间里，等待天黑。

先洗了个澡。跑了这么些天，身上又是土又是汗，河水一泡，浑身舒坦。洗完了，换上一身干净衣服，开始做饭。

今天不想吃大鱼大肉了，就想吃点清淡的。从空间菜地里摘了几个西红柿、几根黄瓜、几个青椒，又拔了两根葱。西红柿炒鸡蛋，凉拌黄瓜，青椒炒肉丝——肉丝是猪肉，切得细细的。

主食是手擀面。自己和面、擀面、切面，面条切得细细的，下到锅里煮三滚，捞出来过一下凉水，爽滑劲道。把炒好的菜倒在面条上，满满一大盘，红的绿的黄的，看着就有食欲。

王建新端着盘子，坐在茶几前，大口大口地吃。面条筋道，菜炒得香，吃得很香。一大盘吃得干干净净，连菜汤都喝了。

吃饱喝足，又给大毛它们喂食。从冰库里拿出一些生肉，切成大块，扔在地上。大毛、二毛、三毛、四毛扑上去就吃，吃得呜呜叫。

五毛却站在一边，闻了闻生肉，扭头走了。

“五毛，过来吃。”王建新喊了一声。

五毛回头看了看他，又看了看生肉，一脸嫌弃的样子。这狗吃惯了王建新给的剩饭——米饭、面条、炒菜、骨头汤，现在居然还不爱吃生肉了。

王建新没搭理它，不吃就饿着。他转身去抱小狐狸。

五毛一看王建新的表情，知道没希望了。它耷拉着脑袋，慢慢地走到生肉跟前，闻了闻，又闻了闻，然后叼起一块，跑到角落里啃去了。啃了几口，大概觉得味道也不错，吃得越来越快，不一会就把自己那份吃完了，还跑去抢二毛的。

王建新抱着小狐狸，和小家伙玩了一会。小狐狸长大了些，毛色还是灰不溜秋的，但现在毛发油亮，摸上去滑溜溜的。脸胖乎乎的，圆滚滚的，眼睛亮晶晶的，虽然还是有点丑，但属于丑萌丑萌那种类型的。主要吃得胖，王建新天天喂它牛奶、肉末、鸡蛋黄，长得跟个小肉球似的。

小狐狸趴在王建新腿上，眯着眼睛，让他挠下巴。王建新挠了挠，小狐狸发出咕噜咕噜的声音，像猫一样。

玩了一会，王建新把小狐狸放在沙发上，来到河边，盘膝打坐，开始修炼。

这段时间没咋好好修炼，东奔西跑的，功法落下了不少。正好补上。

灵气在体内运转，一个周天，两个周天，三个周天……空间里的灵气比外面浓得多，尤其是河边这块地方，灵气往身上扑。王建新沉下心来，引导灵气在经脉里循环，把这段时间积累的那些零散灵气全部炼化吸收。

也不知道修炼了多长时间，等他从入定中醒来，发现外面天已经很黑了。空间里的手表时间不准确——在空间里待久了，机械表和外面的时间也不一样，他也不知道现在是几点。

不管了，出发。

王建新趁着夜色潜伏，绕过了车站，又找到了火车道。巴统的车站肯定也被戒严了，不能从车站走，得沿着铁路线找火车。

他在铁路边找了个隐蔽的地方，等着。还别说，没一会就过来一列火车。车头灯从远处射过来，铁轨开始震动，一列长长的客车轰隆隆地开过来。王建新看了一眼车厢上的标识——去莫斯科的。

“正好是他要等的车。”

他瞅准时机，轻轻一跃，跳上了火车。这是一列客车，最后一节是行李车厢，里面堆着一些杂物，没人。他钻进行李箱的角落里，进入空间。

Wang Jianxin drove towards Batumi, but felt something was wrong before he even entered the city.

There were a lot of military police on the road, and checkpoints were one after another.Passing vehicles will be stopped for investigation, and even pedestrians will be stopped. From time to time, they will be called to the roadside for questioning.The atmosphere on the street is very tense. It seems that they want to find some clues, but they never dreamed that there are people with space, right?

"It seems that martial law has also been imposed in Batumi." Wang Jianxin knew what he was doing.He did so many things in the Soviet Union, in Moscow and Batumi, so many things were lost in warehouses, and bank vaults were looted. It was impossible for the military to fail to respond.Now the entire Soviet Union is probably under strict investigation.

He quickly found a place where no one was and put the car into the space, and then hid in the space and waited for dark.

I took a shower first.After running for so many days, my body was covered with dirt and sweat. A dip in the river water made my whole body feel comfortable.After washing, I put on clean clothes and started cooking.

I don’t want to eat big fish or meat today, so I just want to eat something light.I picked a few tomatoes, a few cucumbers, a few green peppers, and two green onions from the space vegetable patch.Stir-fried eggs with tomatoes, cold cucumbers, and fried shredded pork with green peppers - the shredded pork is finely chopped.

The staple food is hand-made noodles.Knead, roll, and cut the noodles by yourself. Cut the noodles into thin pieces. Boil them in a pot for three times, then take them out and run them under cold water until they become smooth and chewy.Pour the fried vegetables on the noodles, and fill a big plate with them, red, green, and yellow, which makes you appetizing.

Wang Jianxin held the plate, sat in front of the coffee table, and ate heartily.The noodles are chewy, the vegetables are fried and delicious.I ate a large plate and even drank the vegetable soup.

Eat and drink enough, and feed Da Mao and them.Take out some raw meat from the freezer, cut it into large pieces, and throw it on the ground.Da Mao, Er Mao, San Mao and Si Mao pounced on them and ate them, making them whine as they ate.

Wu Mao stood aside, smelled the raw meat, and turned away.

"Fifty cents, come here and eat." Wang Jianxin shouted.

Wu Mao looked back at him, then at the raw meat, with a look of disgust on his face.This dog is used to the leftovers provided by Wang Jianxin - rice, noodles, stir-fried vegetables, and bone soup. Now it doesn't like eating raw meat anymore.

Wang Jianxin ignored it and was hungry if he didn't eat.He turned around to hug the little fox.

Wumao looked at Wang Jianxin's expression and knew there was no hope.It drooped its head, walked slowly to the raw meat, smelled it, smelled it again, then picked up a piece and ran to the corner to chew it.After taking a few bites, I thought it tasted good, so I ate faster and faster. After a while, I finished my portion, and even ran to grab the two cents.

Wang Jianxin held the little fox and played with the little guy for a while.The little fox has grown up a bit, and its fur is still gray, but now its fur is shiny and slippery to the touch.The face is chubby and round, and the eyes are bright. Although it is still a bit ugly, it belongs to the ugly and cute type.It mainly eats to make it fat. Wang Jianxin feeds it milk, minced meat, and egg yolk every day, until it looks like a small meat ball.

The little fox lay on Wang Jianxin's lap, squinting his eyes and letting him scratch his chin.Wang Jianxin scratched it, and the little fox purred like a cat.

After playing for a while, Wang Jianxin put the little fox on the sofa, came to the river, sat cross-legged, meditated, and started practicing.

I didn't practice well during this period. I was running around here and there, and my skills fell behind a lot.Just make up for it.

The spiritual energy circulates in the body, one week, two weeks, three weeks... The spiritual energy in the space is much denser than outside, especially in the area by the river, where the spiritual energy rushes towards the body.Wang Jianxin calmed down, guided the spiritual energy to circulate in his meridians, and refined and absorbed all the scattered spiritual energy accumulated during this period.

He didn't know how long he had been practicing. When he woke up from trance, he found that it was already dark outside.The time on the watch in space was inaccurate - after staying in space for a long time, the time on the mechanical watch was different from the time outside, and he didn't know what time it was.

No matter, let's go.

Wang Jianxin took advantage of the night to lurk around the station and found the train track.The station in Batumi must also be under martial law. You cannot walk from the station and you have to follow the railway line to find the train.

He found a secluded place by the railway and waited.Not to mention, a train will come soon.Headlights came from a distance, the railway tracks began to vibrate, and a long line of passenger cars rumbled over.Wang Jianxin glanced at the sign on the carriage - bound for Moscow.

"It's exactly the car he was waiting for."

He saw the right moment, jumped on the train with a slight jump.This is a passenger car, and the last car is a luggage compartment with some sundries piled in it but no one is there.He ducked into the corner of the trunk and entered the space.
